items.title: A distinct Vault Member sign-in and creation experience
items.why: The existing creation panel sends new members through a sign-in-first screen with dense technical instructions and no clear audience choice.
items.recipe: Create a branded two-audience entry, redesign member sign-in/create/profile-completion states, preserve referral and return intent, and provide open member enrollment with optional referrals. Keep Obelisk credentials and existing membership policy authoritative.
items.acceptance: Real browser sign-in/create/profile/recovery states are readable and navigable across all seven themes and desktop/mobile; current authenticated member and open signup and profile-completion journeys return to the correct member context.
items.userOutcome: Members and investors understand which account journey they are on and reach their intended destination.
items.stageRationale: Founder explicitly expands S409 to improve all sign-in/create and separate branded audience experiences.

premises.claim: The existing creation panel sends new members through a sign-in-first screen with dense technical instructions and no clear audience choice.
premises.pattern: Obelisk opens on its sign-in screen.

L1.recipe: Copy-only patch is insufficient for the founder request and is not selected.

L2.recipe: Create a branded two-audience entry, redesign member sign-in/create/profile-completion states, preserve referral and return intent, and present invite requirements honestly. Keep Obelisk credentials and existing membership policy authoritative.

L3.recipe: New provider trust policy, RLS, entitlements or investor financial content remain outside this experience redesign.

items.title: Restore the premium Investor Relations journey and workspace
items.why: The structurally separate investor portal has an application mislabeled Create account, hardcoded dashboard returns, and no consumed submission confirmation.
items.recipe: Create a premium institutional investor entrance and consistent workspace shell across all subpages. Separate identity creation, investor access request and approval; consolidate the application into its existing route; preserve safe investor destinations and accurate browser submission confirmation. Do not change approval tiers, permissions or financial/private data.
items.acceptance: All investor routes and states receive real rendered review across themes and viewports. Existing approved investors retain exact deep links; signed-in ordinary members can request access without logout or investor data; application failure/retry/confirmation is accurate without inventing server status.
items.userOutcome: Investors reach a recognizably separate premium workspace with clear approved-access boundaries.
items.stageRationale: Founder explicitly expands S409 to improve all sign-in/create and separate branded audience experiences.

premises.claim: The structurally separate investor portal has an application mislabeled Create account, hardcoded dashboard returns, and no consumed submission confirmation.

Do not change approval tiers, permissions or financial/private data.

items.title: Preserve audience and initiating mode through secure identity recovery
items.why: Member failures change sign-in into registration, and invalid/expired callback failures default to membership even for investors.
items.recipe: Preserve trusted initiating intent and audience in the existing signed flow. Use a neutral audience chooser when no trusted flow survives; preserve fail-closed state, nonce, PKCE and access gates. Verify provider-supported signup behavior before promising it; coordinate owner dependencies through Ark.
items.acceptance: Regression tests prove cancellation, provider errors, expiry, invalid state and hostile return targets remain fail closed with correct audience recovery. Affected real authorized member/investor/private-data journeys are required separately; anonymous denials and fixtures do not substitute.
items.userOutcome: Members and investors understand which account journey they are on and reach their intended destination.
